title: UFV-04 (AC-17 / SPEC R4 fork child env): this fork assertion has not run under the real fork project
severity_rationale: S2 by the plan: an unexecuted rail assertion can hide a fork-mode leak. Capital none: no fork test runs against live funds and the bot is off.

evidence.note: Assertion: the first real npm run test:fork starts Hardhat with the sanitized env from buildHardhatChildEnv, the fork works, and the Hardhat child's ledger records a blocked .env read (the child env carries no CSB_RAIL_RUN_ID, so its ledger is under <tmp>/crypto-snipe-bot-rail-ledger/no-run) Why not run: starting Hardhat is out of Phase 22 scope (AC-08) Rehearsal: none (Hardhat cannot be rehearsed without starting it) Result: not rehearsed

sibling_sites_checked: Each entry of unrun-fork-verifications.json has one obligation. Proven meanwhile by: test/unit/rails/hardhatChildEnv.test.ts (the pure env, a railed child on the same setup-fork preload, and an AST check of every child launch in test/fork/setup.ts)
escaped_regression: A Hardhat child that still reads the real .env (through a code path AST and unit tests do not cover) would be invisible, because Hardhat has never been started under this environment.
recommendation: Run it by name at the first npm run test:fork of v7.0, owner Phase 25 (ROADMAP Phase 25 success criterion 3) or any earlier phase that runs the fork suite, and record pass or fail for this named assertion.
